info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Miles-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Miles Retrieval API provides an efficient way to access information about airline flights in terms of miles. Users can retrieve details of available flights, including their mileage metrics, to assist in planning and decision-making. This API is especially valuable for travel agencies, frequent flyers, and compliance with loyalty programs, enabling them to get insights into mileage accumulation and flight options. It offers seamless integration for applications aiming to enhance travel experience or data analysis.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed mileage information related to flights, enabling informed travel decisions and tracking of miles earned.
